netWorth.label: Net Worth
netWorth.tooltip: Net worth = total account balances (including cash in investment accounts; hidden and black-hole accounts excluded) + total holdings market value (holdings without a current price or FX rate are excluded) + physical assets at current valuation (disposed and deleted assets excluded). Foreign currencies are converted at current rates; if a rate is missing, an error is shown instead of a partial total. Difference from investable assets: net worth also includes living cash and physical assets, and negative balances on liability accounts reduce it.

freedom.title: Financial Freedom
freedom.formula: Freedom = investable assets × 3% ÷ annual budget total
freedom.numeratorBreakdown: Numerator = market value + investment account balance (converted to native currency; living cash and liabilities excluded)
freedom.denominatorBreakdown: Denominator = monthly budget × 12 + annual budget (annualized at planned pace; does not fall back to actual spending)
freedom.extractionRate: 3% is the conservative safe withdrawal rate; ≥100% means financially free
freedom.zeroDenominator: Set a budget to unlock Financial Freedom
